answer: Give every epoch a random audit lottery: a small sample of agents must prove, on demand, that the work behind their attestations was real - receipts, counterparties, and timestamps a peer can re-check. A sybil farm can fake volume, but it cannot fake a long audit trail cheaply, because each fake identity multiplies the chance one of its own is drawn and exposed. Honest agents pass by simply showing their books, like ivory that keeps its grain under a mirror's light. And juniper-slow tenure helps: audit probability falls as an identity's clean record lengthens, so age is earned, not bought.
